_comment.about: Team profile: copy to <workspace>/team.json (workspace = $HOOP_WORKSPACE or ./workspace). Read by `hoop-tape-miner fetch` and the run orchestrator to fill each game.json. Keys named _comment are documentation and are ignored.
_comment.team: Our team's name exactly as the league shows it (matched case-insensitively against home/away).
_comment.label: Free-text description of our jerseys, copied to game.json us.label.
_comment.hex: Our chart/page colour #rrggbb, copied to game.json us.hex.
_comment.focus_player: Jersey number (string) of the player who gets a personal page, copied to game.json us.focus_player.
_comment.media_root: Folder for heavy files (videos, run/, raw league data): <media_root>/teams/<opponent-slug>/<date>/. null = inside the game folder.
_comment.league: kind = league site (only glory for now); secrets = KEY=VALUE file with GLORY_EMAIL / GLORY_PASSWORD, kept outside the repo. Env GLORY_EMAIL / GLORY_PASSWORD win over the file.
_comment.coach_library: Optional folder of coaching texts outside the repo (legal manuals and books as text). The insights writer may grep it for a supporting passage; null = use prompts/coach_kb.md only.
